instruction: Export the LibreOffice Impress slides as an interactive augmented reality experience for mobile devices.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Impress does not support exporting to augmented reality formats. Creating AR experiences requires specialized development platforms and is far beyond presentation software capabilities.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - LibreOffice Impress has no AR export capabilities
